note: Saint Helena: nationals of the countries listed need no visa before travelling (unless they have a criminal conviction: not modelled) and are given a Short Term Entry Permit on arrival for up to 183 days; everyone else applies online for an electronic visa. Ascension Island (which the game counts with Saint Helena) asks every visitor, British citizens included, for an e-visa (3 months), and Tristan da Cunha permission to land in advance: neither is modelled apart. Read on 2026-11-03 from the Government's own e-Visa site (its passport list, each marked as needing a visa or not) and its pages on entry and the Short Term Entry Permit, which corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on the stay (183 days, not without limit) and on Côte d'Ivoire (no visa). Timor-Leste isn't on the site's passport list; its entry stands on Wikipedia's copy.

Nationals of other countries may apply online for an electronic visa. Ascension Island – Visitors of all nationalities, including British citizens, need a visa for Ascension Island

sources.title: St Helena Government: Short Term Entry Permit
sources.said: An Immigration Officer may grant an entry permit (a “Short Term Entry permit”) to an immigrant who – (a) applies on arrival, for permission to enter St Helena for a period not exceeding 183 days

sources.title: St Helena Government: Entry requirements
sources.said: Landing permission (for stays on-Island of up to 24 hours ). Short-term Entry Permit (for stays on-Island for a period not exceeding 183 days ) Long-Term Entry Permit (for stays on-Island in excess of 183 days ). Visa requirements to enter St Helena Island The St Helena E-visa application website can be found at: https://evisa.sainthelena.gov.sh/
